title: Patellar Tracking
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: It enters the groove as the knee bends, at around 20 to 30 degrees, and becomes progressively more constrained with further flexion.
By 60 to 90 degrees the patella is deep in the groove and bone is the dominant restraint.
Static indices measured at 30 degrees or more sit after engagement in most knees and therefore miss the window.
